subject: Zenara trial: qualification criteria & prompt/data delivery plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@zenarahealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@zenarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Zenara trial: qualification criteria & prompt/data delivery plan

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kicks off. High-level goal is to validate Redwood inference on your triage and reply-generation flows and measure improvements to latency, cost, and relevance for clinical intake use cases.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Intent classification accuracy: >= 88% on labeled sample (per-intent breakdown to avoid masking low-volume intents)
- Response relevance (human-rated): mean >= 4.0 / 5 across a stratified sample
- Hallucination rate <= 5% (as measured by a 200-case blind review)
- 95th percentile API latency <= 250ms end-to-end for single-turn queries under production-like load

Evaluation plan
1) Zenara provides a prompt/log snapshot and expected responses (see template attached). Fields: id, timestamp, prompt, context, expected_response, intent_label, sensitivity_flag.
2) Phase A (pilot): 500 prompts + 200 labeled expected responses — Redwood runs model variants, produces system-generated responses, we run automatic metrics + blinded human review. Target turnaround 5 business days after dataset receipt.
3) Phase B (full trial): up to 2,500 additional prompts/threads (or full export if you prefer) and a broader human evaluation across categories.
4) Deliverables: evaluation report (metrics, confusion matrices, failure modes), example prompts triggering hallucination, and recommended model/config (quantization and batching profile).

Data & security notes
- If PII/PHI present, please follow the transfer instructions below (secure S3 presigned upload + customer-managed KMS). We will not persist raw PII beyond the scoped eval window; retention policy will be 30 days unless you request otherwise.

Ownership & timeline
- Zenara: provide pilot CSV (template attached) by 2026-07-01.
- Redwood (Rafael/SE Karthik/CS Monica): confirm intake location and review redaction plan within 48 hours of upload; run Phase A eval and share report by 2026-07-08.

Next steps (action items)
- Elena: confirm dataset delivery format and whether you need a presigned S3 link or an SFTP option.
- Redwood: send template + presigned upload instructions (I'll follow up in this thread).

Attachments: call recording (call_recording_06152026.mp3), prompt template (zenara_prompt_template_v1.csv)

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Zenara trial: qualification criteria & prompt/data delivery plan

Thanks Rafael — this is helpful and close to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide the pilot CSV by the 1st but note the pilot set will likely contain PHI (patient initials, short notes). We need to confirm your KMS/HSM requirements and whether Redwood will redact on ingestion or if we should preprocess.
- For Phase A, we prefer to start with 400–500 prompts sampled across the triage categories (symptom intake, eligibility questions, appointment scheduling). If the pilot looks good we will expand to ~2,000 in Phase B.
- Can you confirm human review process? Who at Redwood will handle blind evaluation and what instructions will we provide to reviewers?
- Regarding metrics: we also want a recall-focused metric for low-frequency urgent intents — i.e., recall >= 90% for intents labeled URGENT.

Delivery preference: secure S3 presigned upload is fine. We need the presigned URL + KMS key details and a brief checklist for redaction so our data engineering team can prepare. Tentative delivery window: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-05 depending on approvals.

If you can send the presigned link and the template, I will route to our data engineering and legal for signoff.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Product (Clinical) — Zenara Health
elena@zenarahealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Zenara POC - redaction & review workflow

Quick internal note — copying into the customer thread after we confirm items below. Suggested approach to keep Zenara moving: 

1) Two-phase intake to reduce friction:
   - Pilot (Phase A): 500 prompts (customer can deliver 400–500). We will run automated PII detection + preserve a redacted copy for model evaluation. Raw PHI stays encrypted in their bucket and is not pulled into long-term storage.
2) Secure transfer
   - Provide presigned S3 with SSE-KMS and an audit log. We will provide a minimal IAM role and upload instructions.
3) Human review instructions
   - Use three internal reviewers from CS evaluation pool; blind the reviewer to model variant. Review rubric: relevance (1–5), hallucination flag (Y/N), sensitive_content_flag (Y/N). For URGENT intent recall check, use a focused QA pass with 2 annotators per case.
4) Timeline and owners
   - Rafael: confirm template and send presigned link by EOD 6/16.
   - Karthik: prepare SE runbook for evaluation (model variants to test, batching config, expected cost estimate).
   - Monica: coordinate human review and produce evaluation template and quick training doc for reviewers.

I also attached the CSV template (zenara_prompt_template_v1.csv) — it's the same fields Rafael shared. If we need a smaller pilot, we'll accept 300 items to unblock legal.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming we will proceed with the two-phase approach and the secure S3 transfer. Actions from Redwood (below) and attached the upload/checklist and the CSV template again.

Action items we will complete by EOD 2026-06-16:
- Provide presigned S3 upload endpoint with SSE-KMS and minimum IAM policy (link: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/incoming/zenara/).
- Send a short redaction checklist for your engineers describing which fields to remove/replace (names -> initials, full addresses -> city/state, full MRNs removed).
- Karthik will include the SE runbook with the model variants we intend to test and estimated token cost for the pilot.

Confirmed acceptance criteria (short version)
- Pilot: 400–500 prompts delivered in CSV format; Redwood turnaround 5 business days for Phase A evaluation.
- URGENT-intent recall target: >= 90% on the sampled critical set.
- If pilot metrics meet thresholds, move to Phase B (target 2k total prompts) and 10 business day evaluation.

Attachments: zenara_prompt_template_v1.csv, upload_instructions_zenara.pdf (stub)

If that works, please respond with the expected delivery date (pick a day between 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-05) and we'll get the presigned link out immediately.

Best — Rafael
